## Context

- The governance document carried four clusters of false or stale claims:
  the "An editorial board exists" section and its decision-making /
  capture-resistance echoes; the "pending counsel (HG-02)" legal-home scope
  note and "not a public launch" / "Go-public remains blocked" launch
  claims (the site went public 2026-09-16); the "served `/corrections` and
  `/dispute` mechanisms" claim (the durable anonymous receiver is not yet
  operating — the `/dispute/` page itself says so); and the second-reviewer
  "still owed" / HG-02-counsel gatekeeping claims.
- The adopted posture is fixed by landed ADRs with verbatim operator
  sentences: ADR-164/WV-02 (interim single-maintainer editorial authority,
  public decision log), ADR-163/WV-03 (second-reviewer waived for Round-11
  releases; naming stays off, gate denies by default), ADR-165/WV-01
  (legal home = the operator as individual, revisit triggers named),
  ADR-182/WV-07 (counsel-review clauses of SIG-LIC-009/SIG-INGEST-037
  waived), ADR-180/WV-05 (one-click anonymous intake waived for Round 11;
  corrections by e-mail with disclosure), ADR-167/C-3 (the "counsel"
  determinations were the operator's own; there was no counsel).
- `sources.toml` carried exactly five `rights_reviewed_by = "counsel
  (HG-02)"` values (madada, declarationcamera_be, carnegie_ai_gsi,
  facial_recognition_world_map, aspi_mapping_chinas_tech_giants). ADR-167
  decision 2 pins the replacement vocabulary verbatim: "the operator's own
  determination (no counsel)". Only the value changes — the dated `notes`
  records (which mention the counsel attribution inside a dated
  FLIPPED-2026-09-15 record) and `rights_reviewed_on` dates are history
  and stay byte-identical; `ingestion_permitted` is never touched.
- Wording discipline (B-2): the Corrections section states the posture
  only in the operator's adopted sentences, quoted verbatim with their
  round times; the agent-drafted record sentences are pinned as pending
  `GC-*` rows in `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-01.md` awaiting
  the operator's verbatim confirmation at a copy-batch sitting. C-5: no
  "who runs SIG" copy, no operator description beyond the adopted WV-01
  sentence — the 2026-09-15 legal-home text is neither extended nor
  rewritten.
- `docs/governance/contributor-onboarding-usability-study.md:95` carried
  one more live-looking counsel claim ("flagged for counsel review before
  launch") — struck in place with the same dated pointer.
- `docs/build/reports/PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST.md` is append-only (OM-13):
  its counsel claims are never rewritten — a dated `## 2026-10-03 —
  correction` section names every line (:9, :13, :29, :48, :51, :84,
  :144, :164, :176); operator words quoted inside dated records (:75,
  :251) stay verbatim — they record what was said; the correction records
  who made the determinations.
